title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 14, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B9.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C4.4 (Peaked November 14, 2026 at 06:06 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 416 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Energetic particles are keeping things interesting upstairs! 📡⚡🚀

Several active regions and a prominent dark filament are visible on today’s Sun, with no clear large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
